I01.text: Individual fiscal residence is established by a dwelling available as owner, usufructuary or tenant; otherwise principal stay; or the centre of vital economic/professional interests. No automatic day-count test is established here. Treaty allocation and the additional persons in article 4 must be considered.
I01.quote: possèdent une habitation à leur disposition

I02.text: The resident net global income baseline combines category net income without distinguishing domestic from foreign source, subject to treaty provisions. Do not extend this personal rule to companies.
I02.quote: sans qu’il y ait lieu de distinguer que ces revenus ont leur source

I03.text: For employees: annual net taxable income through XAF 378,000 is exempt; the next slice through XAF 1,680,000 is taxed at 8%. Article 86 prints the first endpoint as “378.0000”; article 35(17) and the next slice beginning 378,001 establish the working interpretation. Confirm the defective print before live filing.
I03.quote: le revenu net imposable inférieur ou égal à 378 000 F CFA.

I04.text: Employee annual net-income slice XAF 1,680,001–3,360,000: 15%; XAF 3,360,001–5,040,000: 28%; excess above XAF 5,040,000: 40%. These are marginal bands, not a flat rate on gross pay.

I05.text: Salary base includes cash and benefits. Article 38 allows a 30% professional-expense deduction from gross pay and benefits; article 39 also deducts family allowances and qualifying pension/social contributions. Establish the actual gross, exempt items and deductions before applying the net-income bands.

I06.text: Non-salaried artisan, industrial, commercial and non-commercial activity: 30% profit rate; agricultural activity: 20%, subject to the separate minimum-tax comparison. Do not apply the employee scale to business profit.
supporting_quotes: Le taux de l’impôt est fixé à 30%

I07.text: Individual minimum tax: agricultural turnover at 0.3%, with XAF 300,000 minimum; other turnover at 1.85%, with XAF 1,850,000 minimum. Base is turnover excluding tax plus covered products/profits, rounded down to XAF 1,000; regulated commission intermediaries use gross commissions, and mixed activity is separated. Article 83 preserves its specified exemptions.
supporting_quotes: 300 000 F CFA pour les activités agricoles
1 850 000 F CFA pour les autres activités
arrondie au millier de francs inférieur

I08.text: Article 64 removes income subject to final levies before combining categories. A category loss carries against that category through the third following year; losses from pleasure/vacation properties are excluded. No cross-category loss netting is inferred.
I08.quote: jusqu’à la troisième année qui suit l’année déficitaire.

I09.text: Annual detailed signed return goes to the competent residence/designated tax office by 30 April following the income year; obtain an acknowledgement. Foreign movable assets require the article 88 detailed nature/value/income statement by the same date.

I10.text: For a resident individual receiving distributed investment income, article 84 applies 15% to the gross distribution. Source withholding and its remittance are addressed in the cross-border Guide. This does not verify an undifferentiated royalty rate.

I11.text: Personal capital gains are a separate category under articles 55–57, including movable/immovable rights and real-estate-rich shares. The general base is disposal/market value less acquisition cost; qualifying undeducted capital improvements increase real-estate cost. Enumerated exemptions include the principal residence. This reading does not establish the old separate resident/non-resident CGT rates.
I11.quote: de la cession de la résidence principale ;

I12.text: Employee withholding and the small-employer calendar are in the payroll Guide. Non-salaried taxpayers follow the corporate instalment/payment mechanism by article 115. Excess paid instalments are carried to following instalments under article 119; this is not an automatic cash-refund promise.
I12.quote: l’excédent est considéré comme un crédit

C01.text: Article 121 covers capital companies and other specified profit-making entities, with entity-specific elections/exemptions. The article 122 baseline exempts base-regime companies at turnover no more than XAF 30,000,000 from IS, not from every tax. Do not infer that every legal entity uses the ordinary computation.
supporting_quotes: inferieur ou égal à 30. 000. 000 F CFA

C02.text: Ordinary corporate profits arise from enterprises operated or operations carried out in CAR, subject to treaties. Net profit is products less charges; directly necessary business expenses are deductible subject to the detailed limitations. Foreign branch income has a specific rule in the cross-border Guide, so neither a blanket worldwide nor blanket foreign-income exemption is correct.
C02.quote: les bénéfices réalisés par les entreprises exploitées en République Centrafricaine.

C03.text: Ordinary company profit rate: 30%; agricultural activities: 20%. Compare against the statutory turnover minimum rather than adding the two taxes.
C03.quote: il est réduit à 20% pour les activités agricoles.
supporting_quotes: Le taux de l’impôt est fixé à 30%

C04.text: Corporate minimum: agricultural activity 0.3% with XAF 300,000 floor; other activity 1.85% with XAF 1,850,000 floor. Turnover/products/profits exclude tax, are rounded down to XAF 1,000, and include interest/dividends. Regulated commission intermediaries use gross commissions; mixed activity is tested separately.
supporting_quotes: 300.000 F CFA pour les activités agricoles
arrondie au millier de francs inférieur

C05.text: Article 133 bis-1 exempts the specifically described transport/fire pool co-insurers whose annual turnover is no more than XAF 3,000,000 from the minimum. This narrow exception is not an insurance-sector exemption.

C06.text: A tax loss carries forward against following profits through the third year after the loss year. Track the year and use oldest eligible losses with supporting schedules; this does not establish a carryback.

C07.text: Calendar-year company assessment is based on the preceding twelve-month year. A start within the final six months permits a longer first balance-sheet period, but a provisional 31 December operating account is still taxed and credited against the first final assessment.
supporting_quotes: sur une période de douze mois

C08.text: The baseline annual results return is filed in four copies before 1 May of the following year. The balance due after crediting instalments is payable with DSF no later than 30 April. Do not turn the first-year accounting concession into a filing holiday.
C08.quote: avant le 1er mai de l’année suivante.

C09.text: Normal-real regime instalments: one third of the prior liability each by 15 February, 15 June and 15 October. First instalment uses the penultimate closed year provisionally and is regularised at the second payment.
supporting_quotes: au 1/3 de l’impôt dû l’année précédente

C10.text: Simplified-real instalments: one half of prior liability by 15 March and 15 September; the first provisionally uses the penultimate year and is regularised no later than 15 June. These are separate calendar rules, not universal dates for every company.

C11.text: The 2026 Finance Act replaces article 135 bis and bis-1 DSF wording: four copies and specified supporting schedules; the two provisions now both use real-regime language. Preserve both texts and obtain the implementing interpretation instead of silently allocating the second paragraph to a different taxpayer group.

C12.text: The 2026 visa fiscal checks plausibility, overall consistency, comparability and internal concordance of approved annual statements. It is a distinct engagement, not an audit, limited review, statutory certification or assurance engagement. The taxpayer remains responsible for its information.
C12.quote: ne constituent ni une mission d’audit,

C13.text: Visa fiscal is issued by an expert-comptable or comptable agréé registered with the national order, incompatible with being the entity manager/legal representative. Ministerial order must specify procedures, diligence, attestation and transmission. The added bis-1 text also calls for fiscal-counsel co-certification and retains the statutory auditor DSF-signing prohibition; implementation must be reconciled before submission.

C14.text: Staff remuneration is deductible only for actual work and non-excessive amounts; directors and associated managers have additional conditions. Detailed deductions, depreciation, provisions and interest limits require their own article-level reconciliation before a final tax-base computation.
C14.quote: à un travail effectif et ne sont pas exagérées.

T01.text: Controlled foreign-enterprise transfers of profit through purchase/sale prices, thin capitalisation or other means are added back under article 131. Majority capital ownership directly or through an intermediary, actual decision power and common control count. A privileged-tax/non-cooperative recipient removes the dependence condition.
T01.quote: soit par sous-capitalisation, soit par tout autre moyen

T02.text: A privileged-tax state is one where the enterprise is untaxed or profit/income tax is more than half below the ordinary CAR corporate comparator. Exactly half below does not satisfy this particular limb. Determine comparable tax amounts, not headline rates alone.
T02.quote: inférieur de plus de la moitié

T03.text: Payments to privileged-tax recipients require proof of real operations and amounts that are neither abnormal nor excessive. Amounts paid/due to non-cooperative-state recipients are non-deductible under the distinct rule. The list is the specified OECD/UN/CEMAC list, potentially supplemented by ministerial decision; no operative list is authenticated here.
T03.quote: ne sont pas admises en déduction

T04.text: Covered effective services, head-office/technical/financial/accounting fees, commissions, interest and IP charges paid outside the Community require proof of real, normal, non-excessive operations and cannot exceed 20% of taxable profit before those charges. In a loss year the provision uses the last profitable, non-prescribed result. Rejected sums are treated as distributions.

T05.text: IP royalties also require proof the right remains valid. Article 126 bis 12 contains a separate distribution treatment where royalties benefit an enterprise participating in management/capital of an enterprise outside the Community. Do not treat meeting the fee cap as settling this rule.

T06.text: Purchasing commissions/brokerage for Community enterprises are capped at 5% of purchases by buying centres/intermediaries, with rebates benefiting those enterprises and a regular invoice attached to the supplier invoice. This specific ceiling is not a universal cost-plus margin.
T06.quote: dans la limite de 5% du montant des achats

X01.text: Personal residence and category income are determined in the individual Guide; treaties can allocate taxing rights. For new CAR domicile/residence, income brought into charge by that move is counted only from establishment of that domicile/residence.
X01.quote: ne sont comptés que du jour de cet établissement.

X02.text: A departing resident is assessed on income disposed of through departure, post-last-assessed business profits and income acquired even if not yet received. Provisional return is due at least 30 days before departure and can be completed during the first two months of the next fiscal year. Abandoning every CAR residence follows the same rule.
X02.quote: au moins trente jours avant la date de départ

X03.text: The departing-person clearance rule covers persons other than CAR nationals by origin, including temporary departure and current-year tax. Employer information is due one month before the employee leaves, or by notification of contract rupture. The text includes a bank guarantee of at least 10% annual turnover for permanent-departure certificates of managers of enterprises under audit; do not apply it to every traveller.

X04.text: A company borrowing domestically, transferring funds abroad, or entering state contracts must first provide the stated tax-regularity attestation. LPF article 28 bis gives ordinary validity of three months from signature; one month where a tax debt has a granted stay/moratorium. Debt does not always bar issuance: the statutory not-yet-due or duly stayed conditions apply.
X04.act_article: 2025 supplementary Finance Act arts. 9–10; CGI 393; LPF 28 bis

X05.text: LPF 28 bis attestation is issued by DGID manually or electronically and is the unique administrative tax-status evidence. A valid attestation is required for specified approvals, foreign bank transfers, tax exemption, covered public/large-business supplier payments and exports; implementing issue conditions remain to be read.
X05.act_article: 2025 supplementary Finance Act art. 10; LPF 28 bis
X05.quote: soit manuellement ou par voie électronique.

X06.text: Subject to treaties, a foreign branch/agency belonging to a CAR enterprise has its results attached to and taxed at the parent seat. If precise evidence is missing, results are determined by comparison with similar normally operated CAR enterprises. This qualifies the ordinary territorial corporate base.
X06.quote: doivent être rattachés à ceux de la société mère

X07.text: Foreign service remuneration is subject to 15% withholding as a final levy, subject to treaties. Distributed investment income is withheld at 15% of gross distributions under the separate paragraph. The text does not establish the old draft’s independent 20% royalty rate or an exemption for all foreign interest.
X07.quote: S’agissant des rémunérations des prestations de services versées à l’étranger

X08.text: Amounts withheld under the income prepayment mechanism are remitted by the 15th of the month following invoicing/withholding. Keep the invoice and withholding record; treaty relief must be authenticated before reducing a domestic rate.
X08.quote: au plus tard le 15 du mois suivant

V01.text: Independent economic suppliers are in scope. Receipts/turnover below XAF 30,000,000 excluding VAT are excluded; the administration can compulsorily register liberal professions and can authorise an irrevocable option by legal persons below threshold. Individuals other than liberal professionals cannot opt. Employees are not independent suppliers.

V02.text: General rate 19%; 0% for taxable-product exports supported by customs-endorsed declaration and international transport; 5% only for the article 257 tariff list. Product origin, description and code conditions matter. Do not classify all food, medicines or international services identically.

V03.text: Goods, self-supplies, services including electronic platforms/commissions, intracommunity acquisitions/imports and public orders are addressed by article 248. Aid is taxable where it directly pays for a supply or supplements its price; not every grant is automatically taxable.
V03.quote: complètent le prix d’une opération imposable.

V04.text: The tax base includes the consideration, relevant incidental charges and taxes except VAT. For imports use customs value plus customs/excise duties. Real, invoice-shown discounts and exact pass-through reimbursements are excluded under article 254. Margin taxation is confined to the listed used-goods, travel-intermediation and specified wholesale transactions, not any low-margin business.
V04.quote: Aucune autre activité ne peut donner lieu

V05.text: Credit requires necessary business use, a registered supplier’s compliant invoice, or import declaration and payment proof, or the relevant self-supply declaration/withholding certificate. Claim no later than the end of the second year after VAT became chargeable; do not replace that limit with the credit carryforward rule.
V05.quote: la fin de la deuxième année

V06.text: Apply blocked-credit rules before prorata: accommodation/entertainment have a professional tourism/catering/show exception; petroleum has enumerated operational exceptions; passenger/mixed vehicles have enumerated transport/rental/stock/teaching exceptions. False invoices, specified cash payments and listed gifts/promotional distributions are also restricted. Full classification and cash-threshold reconciliation are necessary.
V06.quote: Cette exclusion ne concerne pas les professionnels

V07.text: Directly attribute taxable-only and exempt-only inputs. Shared inputs use taxable/export turnover divided by total relevant turnover with statutory exclusions. Provisional prorata uses prior actual or new-business forecast receipts; definitive prorata and correction are due with DSF by 30 April following the year. Below 10% prorata no deduction is allowed.
V07.act_article: 2024 Finance Act art. 10 replacing CGI 261–261 bis

V08.text: A supplier cannot claim VAT status before registration and NIU allocation. Invoice fields include supplier name/address/NIU, date, nature, rate, net price, VAT, client identity/tax number and continuous serial number. Preserve accounting/support records for ten years after the entry year; the certified-cash-register implementing order was not read.

V09.text: The 2025 replacement of CGI 275 bis requires a monthly prescribed return and payment by the 15th following the operations month for the real regime. Article 275 bis-1 quarterly route was already expressly repealed in the 2024 replacement; do not revive the 2023 PDF’s quarterly wording. A no-operation month requires the statutory NEANT return.
V09.act_article: 2025 Finance Act art. 11; 2024 Act art. 10, CGI 275 bis/bis-1/bis-2
V09.quote: La taxe exigible est reversée chaque mois
supporting_quotes: au plutard le 15 du mois suivant

V10.text: Article 276 carries VAT deduction credits forward without a time limit, distinct from the deadline to first exercise input deduction. Refund eligibility is limited to listed legal-person cases and conditions: exports, structural withholding/reduced-rate credits, investment above XAF 100,000,000, reciprocal diplomatic/consular cases, or cessation. Current compliance and three consecutive credit months are required.

V11.text: A refund request goes to DGID on its form in the month after the quarter with copies of the three credit returns; exporters also attach EX.1 export evidence, repatriation references and transport documents. A credit claimed for refund cannot be used again next month; rejection triggers the text’s cancellation rule. The full refund route must be checked before electing it.

V12.text: Services used/exploited in CAR are generally there; materially located services follow execution and intangible services the recipient establishment. Where a recipient established in a Community state is not VAT-taxable, article 250(5) instead locates the supply in the state of the provider resident in another member state, notwithstanding paragraphs 2–4; transport/platform rules are separate. Non-established taxable persons designate a solvent accredited resident representative; absent one the customer pays for them. The 2025 replacement also addresses customer withholding for non-residents without a permanent establishment/installation.
V12.act_article: 2024 Finance Act art. 10, CGI 250/250 bis; 2025 Act art. 11

V13.text: The 2025 article 249 replacement preserves specific financial/insurance, non-assujetti property, public-health, authorised-price education, listed medicine and diplomatic exemptions with their conditions. Diplomatic official-use exemption requires reciprocity/quota and DGID invoice visa. Competitive nonprofit operations remain taxable. No broad food exemption is inferred.
V13.quote: lorsqu’elles se situent dans un secteur concurrentiel

V14.text: The 2026 law introduces prior declaration/payment followed by Treasury reimbursement for covered exemptions: public-contract holders, national/international NGOs, investment-charter investors and mining/forest permit holders. Diplomatic/UN-covered cases and gifts to the State/its components are excluded. Listed regional/administrative levies are non-refundable. Obtain the implementing order before applying a cash-flow assumption.
V14.quote: contre un remboursement par le Trésor public

F01.text: The OHADA SARL limits members’ debt exposure to their contributions and can have one individual/legal-person member or several. The SA similarly limits shareholder debt exposure and may have one shareholder. This is not a guarantee against personal guarantees or manager liability.
F01.quote: ne sont responsables des dettes sociales

F02.text: SARL default capital is XAF 1,000,000, divided into equal shares with at least XAF 5,000 nominal value, expressly subject to contrary national provisions. A live CAR national override check remains necessary; the default is not presented as an authenticated local floor.

F03.text: SARL capital is fully subscribed; in-kind contributions are fully paid. Cash shares require at least half nominal value on subscription, with the remainder within two years of RCCM registration under the statutes. The old “all cash fully paid at incorporation” assertion is not the uniform-act default.
F03.quote: la moitié au moins de leur valeur nominale.

F04.text: SA minimum capital is XAF 10,000,000 and fully subscribed before signing statutes. Cash shares require at least one quarter nominal value at subscription; remainder within three years of RCCM registration. The SARL cash fraction does not apply to an SA.
F04.quote: d’un quart au moins de leur valeur nominale.

F05.text: SARL cash funds are deposited immediately against receipt in an approved bank, credit/microfinance institution or a notary’s office in the forming company’s name. Statutes record payment/deposit, and funds become available to the manager on RCCM registration. National deposit/subscription formalities require separate verification.
F05.quote: dans un compte ouvert au nom de la société en formation

F06.text: Except a société en participation, companies require RCCM registration; legal personality begins on registration unless the Act provides otherwise. Signing statutes establishes formation but does not generally make pre-registration existence opposable to third parties.

F07.text: Managers establish annual financial statements and management report. In the article 140 companies the annual statements/report go to statutory auditors at least 45 days before the ordinary meeting, which must be within six months after year-end. Determine whether an auditor is required before applying that delivery duty.
F07.quote: dans les six (6) mois de la clôture

F08.text: GUFE’s published local route is: obtain form/checklist for entity; assemble identity, criminal-record, seat, statutes and capital-deposit evidence as applicable; submit complete dossier and pay at the counter; collect RCCM/tax/affiliation outputs and complete connected tax/social and sector-permit formalities. Its “48 working hours” is a published service statement, not a guaranteed statutory deadline established by this reading.

W01.text: Employer payroll withholding uses monthly net salary and the annual employee scale brought down to a month. Use the salary base and bands owned by the individual Guide; do not substitute old conflicting CNSS percentages into the base.

W02.text: The CGI baseline states employer remittance no later than the 15th of each month. Employers with at most five workers may remit quarterly by the 15th of the following month; the exception concerns remittance, not permission to omit withholding from pay. Confirm current filing instructions and period attribution.
W02.quote: qui ont au plus cinq salariés
supporting_quotes: au plus tard le 15 de chaque mois
le 15 du mois suivant le trimestre

W03.text: Each remittance is accompanied by an administration-provided slip in two copies. Employer annual summary of named employee IRPP withholdings goes in before 31 January. Do not confuse it with the employee annual income return.
W03.quote: un bordereau établi en deux exemplaires

W04.text: On business cession/cessation, tax retained or tax due is paid within ten days of the event under article 112. Foreign-paid CAR-resident salary recipients have the article 111 personal instalment obligation; foreign payment does not remove payroll-income tax.
W04.quote: dans les dix jours de l’évènement.
supporting_quotes: les retenues effectuées ou l’impôt dû

O01.text: The fiscal year is twelve months from 1 January to 31 December, and “administration fiscale” means DGID in the amended LPF definitions. The specific taxpayer computation and due-date rules remain separate. Amounts in the signed budgets are FCFA; this Guide uses XAF/FCFA units without implying an exchange rate.

O02.text: Amended LPF 243(1): missing/late registration, return, annex or registration/publicity act attracts XAF 500,000; recurrence within a week XAF 1,000,000. This is the general text, not a conclusion that every special fine is cumulative or displaced.

O03.text: Amended LPF 243(2): omissions/inaccuracies in the specified return/annex/act carry 25% of duty; bad faith/fraud 50–100%. LPF 243(7) failure of declaration/payment methods is 25%, escalating to 50–100% for the stated fraud/resistance conduct. The applicable degree must be evidenced, not automatically set to the maximum.
O03.quote: la pénalité est de 25% des droits dus

O04.text: Missing required DGID tax-free invoice visa for VAT exemption attracts XAF 50,000 per detected breach under the new LPF 243(10). Confirm the exemption/payment mechanism and specific act before assessing liability.

O05.text: Written penalty/interest notification must identify taxpayer and offence, calculation, issue date, appeal right, appeal conditions and payment period. Preserve the actual notice and service evidence before choosing a response.
O05.quote: les conditions d’introduction de ce recours

O06.text: Amended LPF 88 requires response to a written information request within a period not exceeding ten days of receipt; on-site missing-support minutes can make later production inadmissible in the stated dispute phases. This is not the old general twenty-day adjustment-response rule.
O06.quote: dix (10) jours à compter de la réception

O07.text: The administration has 90 days from receipt of a tax complaint to notify its decision; no notification by expiry means deemed acceptance under amended LPF 171. An agent cannot sign a dispute decision concerning an adjustment/tax they originated. Actual complaint admissibility, service and full appeal route require the complete LPF.

B01.text: Built-property contribution applies annually to masonry-founded houses, factories, shops, hangars and factories, with attached industrial plant under article 168 and exemptions in article 169. It is distinct from income tax on rent and VAT.
B01.quote: reposant sur des fondations en maçonnerie

B02.text: Built-property base is rental value less a 40% allowance for deterioration, maintenance and repairs. Rental value is determined annually with the property position at 1 January and cannot be below 12% of market value or fixed-asset cost; round the base down to XAF 1,000.

B03.text: Rate is 15% for individuals and legal persons not subject to IS, or 30% for IS-liable legal persons; nearest-XAF-10 rounding and XAF 30,000 minimum. Establish the taxpayer category and exemption first; this is not an across-the-board tax on market value.
supporting_quotes: à la dizaine de francs la plus voisine

B04.text: The article 169 exemptions include the first residential property occupied as the owner/family’s principal home. Other exemptions have public-purpose, ownership, location or non-income conditions. A first-home exemption is not an exemption for all rental properties.
B04.quote: occupée à titre principal par le propriétaire

B05.text: Each owner/debtor, including statutory exemption beneficiaries, submits one administration form per property before 1 February, model F66. The administration’s rental-value notice model F61 bis has a twenty-day approval/correction response. Current forms themselves were not fetched.

B06.text: Tenants, including diplomatic/consular and international bodies, file the specified landlord/property/rent statement before 15 January, model F67. Failure to declare rent timely can also deny the tenant’s income-tax deduction.

B07.text: The liable owner is identified at 1 January; usufruct, emphyteutic lease and building-on-another’s-land rules allocate liability differently. Assessment is at the property’s location, and payment is due by 31 March.

B08.text: Individual net property income is gross rents less the statutory 40% charge allowance. Gross rents include tenant-borne owner expenses and relevant subsidies/indemnities, less landlord-borne tenant expenses. This category calculation is separate from the annual built-property contribution and does not alone establish final IRPP.
B08.quote: sont fixées à 40 % du revenu brut.

O08.text: The signed 2024 Finance Act art.11 creates the LPF annexed to the CGI; only the creation and opening scope were read here, not the complete procedural book.
O08.quote: Il est crée un Livre des Procédures Fiscales annéxé au Code Général des Impôts
O08.read_scope: Art.11 and opening LPF art.1, actual scan visually read; complete LPF and current chain not certified.
